troubleshootPage.title: Troubleshoot
troubleshootPage.subTitle: Does the app not work as expected? Here you can find some common solutions to problems.

firewall.symptom: This device can send files to other devices but other devices cannot send files to this device.
firewall.solution: This is most likely a firewall issue. You can solve this by allowing incoming connections (UDP and TCP) on port {port}.

noDiscovery.symptom: This device cannot discover other devices.
noDiscovery.solution: Please make sure that all devices are on the same Wi-Fi network and share the same configuration (port, multicast address, encryption). You can try to type the IP address of the target device manually. If this works, consider adding this device to the favorites so it can be automatically discovered in the future.

noConnection.symptom: Both devices cannot discover each other nor can they share files.
noConnection.solution: Does the problem exist on both sides? If so, you need to make sure that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network and share the same configuration (port, multicast address, encryption). The Wi-Fi network may not allow communication between participants due to Access Point (AP) Isolation. In this case, this option must be disabled on the router.

changes: Create named workspaces with custom paths and copyable links.
Remember authorized workspace folders on macOS and restart sharing from the workspace page.
Enable workspace uploads once; authorized visitors can upload and retry without repeated prompts.
Select a mobile album in batches, or select multiple photos and videos on desktop.
Queue files and folders, and manage sending and receiving together.
Preview and search shared content in a browser.
Simpler workspace forms and fewer explanatory labels.

transportSecurity.title: HTTPS transport (TLS)
transportSecurity.description: Protects data while it travels between devices. This does not encrypt saved files or add a file password.
transportSecurity.certificate: LegnaSend uses a locally generated, self-signed TLS certificate. Your browser may show a certificate trust prompt for this device.
transportSecurity.httpDescription: HTTPS transport is off. Data is transferred using HTTP without TLS protection. Enable HTTPS transport (TLS) to protect the connection; saved files are unchanged.
transportSecurity.discoveryHint: Check network reachability, discovery port and multicast settings, and the HTTP/HTTPS configuration. If discovery fails, try the target IP and its actual server port.
transportSecurity.connectionHint: Check that the target IP and actual server port are reachable and that HTTP/HTTPS settings are compatible. Wi-Fi access point isolation or a firewall can prevent devices from communicating.
transportSecurity.updateFailed: Transport could not be changed. Check the current service state and retry.

integrationApi.title: API
integrationApi.subtitle: Local integrations, on your existing sharing port.
integrationApi.isolation: API controls do not stop native transfers or browser workspaces.
integrationApi.previous: Previous policy may still be active
integrationApi.failed: The change could not be saved or applied. Retry below.
integrationApi.corrupt: Stored API settings need recovery. The original data is preserved; retry loading or explicitly reset.
integrationApi.resetHint: Remove all API keys and restore disabled defaults. Native transfers and workspace files are preserved.
integrationApi.addressHint: Use the actual address and trust the device certificate for HTTPS. Network tags describe interfaces, not a verified VPN bypass.
integrationApi.fixedWindow: Second and minute fixed windows apply together. Concurrency counts active responses, not connections or bandwidth. 0 disables only that quota; server resource ceilings still apply.
integrationApi.originsHint: One canonical http(s) origin per line, without a path. Same-origin calls remain allowed.
integrationApi.anonymousHint: Without a key, only assigned visible, unprotected workspaces are readable. Hidden/protected workspaces and request history stay closed. An invalid key never falls back to anonymous.
integrationApi.disableHint: Stop integration API responses only. Other shares and original LocalSend transfers continue.
integrationApi.onceHint: The plaintext is shown only here and is not saved. This reusable key works until revoked or expired. Closing this dialog does not copy it automatically.
integrationApi.revokeHint: Revoke this key and end its active API responses. Other keys and native transfers continue.
integrationApi.removedLive: A removed key may still be live until the pending policy is applied. Retry the update.
integrationApi.grantHint: Grant only required actions and workspaces. Upload and workspace management are separate opt-in permissions; existing/default keys remain read-only.
integrationApi.invalid: Check the name, limits, origins and selected permissions/workspaces.
integrationApi.nextStage: Explicit keys can upload, manage workspaces from locally approved sources, and discover devices or control their own API-created send tasks. General cache/settings APIs and unrelated native-task control remain planned.
integrationApi.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it manually.
integrationApi.fallback: API text is shown in English.
integrationApi.documentationHint: Offline guide: setup, permissions, every endpoint, parameters, errors, retries and cURL / JavaScript / Python examples.

apiExplorer.title: API explorer
apiExplorer.hint: Requests use the actual local listener and its authentication/quotas. Reads allow 12 seconds, workspace operations 35 seconds, and uploads a size-based budget. Requests and credentials are not saved.
apiExplorer.tokenHint: Paste a generated key, or leave empty to test anonymous access. Kept only while this page is open; never inserted into examples.
apiExplorer.invalid: Check required fields and parameter limits.
apiExplorer.failed: The request failed or the service changed. Retry against the current listener.
apiExplorer.truncated: Body capped at 256 KiB (binary sample: 4 KiB). This is not a complete download.
apiExplorer.binary: Hexadecimal file sample, not a saved file. Default Range is bytes=0-4095.
